player_prompt.intro:
A nyi {role} to Colonel Blotto.
Nu wè è do gandogo nyi ɖo tɔn ɖo to wiwe.
To kila kɛ, to ka do ɖo {num_total_units} ɖo to agbo {field_names} tɔn.
Mɛ to ka do ɖo ɖo agbo ɖo wɛ mɛ ɖo agbo ɖo, mɛ to wɛ ɖo agbo ɖo wɛ ɖo kɛ.
Apɛ, '[A7 B7 C6]' do ɖo 7 ɖo A, 7 ɖo B, bɔ 6 ɖo C.
